paper_metadata.title: Python-Integrated Quantum–Classical Computing Framework for Intelligent Time-Series Prediction

summary: The paper proposes a hybrid variational quantum circuit model for time-series prediction implemented in Python with Qiskit Aer simulation. On synthetic and financial datasets (30k–120k records), the hybrid model reports 93.7% prediction accuracy versus 89.3% for a classical baseline, with MSE 0.014, correlation 0.92, 22% faster training, and 18% lower execution latency, but all results are obtained on a simulator with unspecified quantum resources.

experiments.description: Python-integrated hybrid quantum-classical time-series prediction using variational quantum circuits with rotation encoding and entanglement layers, evaluated on synthetic nonlinear data and real financial series against classical baselines.

algorithm.variant: Python-integrated hybrid quantum-classical variational quantum circuit for time-series prediction
algorithm.ansatz: parameterized rotation gates with entanglement layers

problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize combined loss L_total = α L_quantum + (1 − α) L_classical
